The '''Lexas Prime system''' was located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] known as the [[Lexas systems]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lexas Prime system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-10.<ref name="TEA" />
